```
def color_stats(board, color):
    positions = []
    for i in range(64):
        if board[i] == color:
            positions.append(i)
    n = len(positions)
    if n == 0:
        return 0, 0.0, 0
    # components
    visited = [False]*64
    comps = 0
    for i in positions:
        if not visited[i]:
            comps += 1
            stack = [i]
            visited[i] = True
            while stack:
                idx = stack.pop()
                for ni in NEIGHBORS[idx]:
                    if board[ni] == color and not visited[ni]:
                        visited[ni] = True
                        stack.append(ni)
    # centroid and avg distance squared
    sum_r = 0; sum_c = 0
    for i in positions:
        r = i // 8; c = i % 8
        sum_r += r; sum_c += c
    mean_r = sum_r / n; mean_c = sum_c / n
    sq = 0.0
    for i in positions:
        r = i // 8; c = i % 8
        sq += (r-mean_r)**2 + (c-mean_c)**2
    avg_dist = sq / n
    return comps, avg_dist, n
```
